T: Back to the island. Bring snacks.
D: A team heads to a remote equatorial island to collect dinosaur DNA and picks up a stranded family on the way.
P: Serve the snacks when the team reaches the island.
S: the hot jungle island near the equator
Pineapple, mango, papaya and passionfruit cut and piled on banana leaves, with lime and chilli salt.
Crackers topped with cheddar, salami and a slice of pickle, laid out in rows like boat rations.
Prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime butter, piled on a platter with lime wedges.
M: the mercenary team on the boat
Snapper fillets rubbed with lime and chilli, grilled in banana leaves for 10 minutes, with coconut rice.
the abandoned research facility on the island
Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chilli, cumin and tomato until thick, served with cornbread.
W: the dinosaur eggs they set out to collect
Dark chocolate mousse set in glasses for 3 hours, topped with crushed chocolate biscuit soil and a speckled chocolate egg.
K: Coconut water, pineapple juice and lime with mint over ice.

s.note: the hot jungle island near the equator
s.how: Lay banana leaves on a big platter. Cut a pineapple, 2 mangoes and half a papaya into wedges and pile on top with halved passionfruit. Squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with a little salt mixed with chilli.

Toss 600g green prawns with crushed garlic, chopped red chilli, lime zest and melted butter. Grill for 2 minutes a side until charred. Pile onto a platter with lime wedges and pour over the butter from the pan.

m.note: the mercenary team on the boat
m.how: Rub 4 snapper fillets with lime juice, chopped red chilli and salt. Wrap each in a softened banana leaf and grill for 10 minutes. Cook jasmine rice in coconut milk with a pinch of salt. Serve the fish in its leaf on the rice.

w.note: the dinosaur eggs they set out to collect
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate and cool slightly. Whip 300ml cream and whisk 3 egg whites to soft peaks. Stir yolks into the chocolate, then fold in cream and whites. Spoon into glasses and chill 3 hours. Top with crushed chocolate biscuits and a speckled egg.

d.how: Fill tall glasses with ice and a few mint leaves. Pour in equal parts coconut water and pineapple juice, then squeeze in a wedge of lime. Stir and serve cold, like a drink on a boat heading somewhere it should not.
